review.assessment: The change introduces collision detection via a `taken` set and appends numeric suffixes to base slugs when truncation causes duplicates, correctly shrinking the base prefix as suffix length grows. However, it contains an off-by-one error in the counter initialization that skips `-1` entirely. This breaks expected sequential numbering for subsequent articles sharing a truncated title.

findings.actual: The first collision receives `-2`, skipping `-1`. Subsequent collisions continue incrementing from there (`-3`, etc.).
findings.call: python run.py with two articles whose titles truncate to the same slug
findings.expected: The first colliding article receives `-1` as its numeric suffix, the second gets `-2`, and so on.
